issue_context.title: LE Audio: Broadcast audio sample
issue_context.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
Add a broadcast audio sample for the broadcast source and broadcast sink. 

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Implement two new samples for a broadcast source and broadcast sink using the `bluetooth/audio/audio.h` API. 

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
N/A

**Additional context**
N/A

review_comments: To handle jitter I would initially push two SDU's to the controller - that way you always have one in the controller to transmit while preparing another in the host stack. This will prevent gabs in the data stream.
Added a `BROADCAST_ENQUEUE_COUNT` value (set to 2) to enqueue 2 packets per BIS.
Great with this call-back - that is the right way to drive the flow of data!

I know it is not directly related to this change, but it is not obvious why an audio sink needs to provide a codec configuration to synchronize to a broadcast - normally it is the opposite that the sink is "told" by the broadcaster which codec to use.
Maybe add a few lines to the documentation about why this is needed, and from where the codec config should be obtained?
I actually think the codec parameter should be removed and the codec parameters from the big-info should be set by the host stack - if the provided codec config is not a 100% match to the one used on the broadcaster side it will not be able to decode the audio..

Looking at the implementation, it doesn't look like the broadcast_sink needs a `codec` parameter anymore. I think this is a leftover from an older version where we probably needed to set a codec to avoid failing some check somewhere, but now that the roles have been split more, as well as improvements to the ISO API, I think we can remove this. 

Created https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/44455 for this
